doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

title: Meeting Bunk Johnson in Lake Charles
summary: De De says he met Bunk Johnson years later in Lake Charles with a drummer named Foster; Bunk had false teeth but still played strongly.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, another trumpet I was going to ask you about, did you hear of Bunk Johnson ever when you were young?
No, not when I was young. I heard him years after though. I met him in Lake Charles, recently, yeah.
Do you remember who he was playing with or what?
At the time he was playing with, well, I know one of them then. That was a brother like Chiney. Chiney, what he was called Chiney with a drummer with Celeste Ant one time.
Foster, Foster, yeah. Abbey Foster, yes. And he was with Bunk then? Yeah, he was with Bunk Johnson then. Oh, yeah. At that time.
Oh, played swell. Did he? He was known as, you know, good drummer play at the time.
Yeah. Did he have, he didn't have false teeth then? Did he have his own teeth then?
No, when I met him he had false teeth. He had false teeth?
Yeah, but he still was playing.

He was strong at the time. It's been about, I don't know, 15 years. Huh? It's been about 15 years. Oh, that's before you know I married, married 24 years. Yeah, yeah, I met him in a minute. I met him in a minute. Yes, we might put that.
When were you married? I was married, this is the 28th of March past, 24 years. 24 years ago.
Well, I didn't know you then, when you were playing with Bunk in a minute. Oh, that's right, yeah.
